headline: Cameroon: transferable oil revenues fall 21.3% in first half of 2026
summary: Cameroon's transferable oil revenues declined 21.3% in the first half of 2026. The full article is restricted to members, so no further detail is available.
why: Oil revenues are a significant source of government income for Cameroon, so a drop affects public finances and fiscal capacity.
original_headline: Cameroun : les recettes pétrolières transférables reculent de 21,3 % au premier semestre 2026
